create.name: Ashtanga Cascais Yoga Shala
create.bio:
Ashtanga Cascais Yoga Shala has taught traditional Ashtanga in Cascais, on the coast west of Lisbon, since 2007. It was co-founded by Vera Simões, who first studied at the Pattabhi Jois institute in Mysore in 2007, was authorised by Sharath Jois in 2010 and renewed that authorisation at Level 2 in 2016. She has taught yoga since 2003, writes the school's long-running blog and is the author of the Portuguese book Parar. Sentir. Respirar. Jo Bento, a former professional surfer who has practised for over ten years, teaches the evening classes.

Morning sessions follow the Mysore method: each class opens with a short sitting meditation, then beginners are taken through the basics step by step while experienced students practise their own series with individual adjustments, ending in guided rest. A traditional led class runs early on Fridays, and there are online classes alongside the in-person room. Over almost two decades the shala has hosted workshops with senior Ashtanga teachers such as Peter Sanson, Sharmila Desai and Hamish Hendry, and it runs weekend retreats in the Portuguese countryside and on the Costa Vicentina that combine Ashtanga, meditation, walks and surfing. Teaching is in Portuguese and English.

courses.title: Mysore Style and led Ashtanga classes
courses.description: Morning Mysore sessions that begin with meditation and end with guided rest, evening classes, a traditional led class on Friday mornings, and online classes. Beginners are taught the foundations one to one inside the group; private classes are available on request.

courses.title: Ashtanga Yoga, Surf & Lifestyle retreats
courses.description: Weekend retreats held in rural Alentejo and on the Costa Vicentina, taught by Vera Simões and Jo Bento, with daily Ashtanga and meditation, talks, shared meals, walks and surfing. New dates are announced on this page.

courses.title: Workshops with Vera Simões and visiting authorised teachers
courses.description: Intensive workshops at the shala, either led by Vera Simões or by visiting teachers authorised in Mysore, open to newcomers and experienced students. Upcoming and past workshops are listed on this page.
